sources.title: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B Model - emergentmind.com
sources.snippet: The paper presents a 1.5B dense language model distilled via supervised fine-tuning from DeepSeek-R1, inheriting advanced chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities. It demonstrates significant performance gains on benchmarks like AIME2024 and MATH-500, outperforming larger instruction-tuned models in logical and mathematical tasks.
